epic.title: EPIC-000: Foundation Infrastructure
epic.description: Setup des composants d'infrastructure partagés nécessaires à tous les Epics. Story 0.1: Shared Infrastructure Setup. Story 0.2: Database Forward Migrations + Seed Data.

stories.title: [Story 0.1] Shared Infrastructure Setup
stories.description: As a developer I want the shared infrastructure components configured and ready So that all subsequent stories can build on a solid foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the project structure (Sprint 0 complete), When this story is implemented, Then the following are configured and tested: PromptApiClient bean (WebClient, 40s timeout for wizard, 60s for processor) in both services, PromptTemplateRegistrar for registering prompt templates on startup, EmailService interface + SendGrid implementation skeleton, KafkaConfig with all 8 topic definitions, RedisConfig for wizard rate limiting, Resilience4j CircuitBreaker configuration per LLM provider, Flyway baseline configuration, geo-flink-jobs Maven module created with Flink 1.20 dependencies
This is the ONLY technical-only story. All subsequent stories deliver user value.
No database tables created here — tables created just-in-time in each story.

stories.title: [Story 0.2] Database Forward Migrations + Seed Data
stories.description: As the development team, I want all remaining database tables created and a complete BMW report seeded, So that Epic 3 (Pipeline) can start in parallel with Epic 2 (Wizard) without waiting for the wizard UI to produce data.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Config-manager migrations — 4 new Flyway migrations create: category_translations, questions, llm_configurations, report_job_queue
AC2: Analysis-processor migrations — 4 new Flyway migrations create: snapshots, llm_responses, response_sources, domain_classifications
AC3: Config-manager JPA entities — CategoryTranslation, Question, LlmConfiguration, ReportJobQueue with correct inheritance and @SQLRestriction
AC4: Analysis-processor JPA entities — Snapshot, LlmResponse, ResponseSource, DomainClassification with correct inheritance and @SQLRestriction
AC5: Config-manager repositories for all new entities
AC6: Analysis-processor repositories for all new entities
AC7: All missing enums created: JobStatus, ResponseStatus, QuestionType, SourceType, SourceCategory, SummaryScope
AC8: Seed migration inserts a complete BMW report configuration: 1 report (PENDING), 2 markets, 3 categories, 6 category_translations, ~96 questions, 5 llm_configurations, 1 report_job_queue entry
AC9: Both services start successfully with all migrations applied
AC10: Existing tests pass — cd backend && mvn verify passes with zero regressions
